steps.note: S1.1.1.1.1 states that the first two rows subtract Ja+Rc, the middle rows add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), the last two restore a,c, so the targets change by (JV+RG)x whatever a,c are.
S1.1.1.1.2 gives the central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one pairs, zero for distinct triples meeting in zero or two points, and self coefficient 3≡1.
The plan's coefficient step (S1.1.1.1.2) and S1.1.1 are bit-case only; the complex central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 and the cancellation of intersections zero and two appear nowhere.
S1.1.1.1.3 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) and that each invocation restores its own auxiliary wires (also in the S1.1.1.1 claim).
The plan never gives the per-edge residual table (residuals and dimensions such as B⊗t_X^⊥ of (a-1)(h-1), P⊗F of h); it states only the center 3->4 loss and the side-edge label inclusion.

S1.1.1.3.3 gives the side-edge labels at times 2 and 5 and says the inclusion holds only because t_X⊥t_Y, but it does not state the complement ⟨t_X,t_Y⟩^⊥ of dimension h-2, so this is a judgement call on the inclusion argument being the defining content.
S1.1.1.3.4 says the only decrease is center 3->4 removing P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h with L=Ich, and S1.1.1.3.5 telescopes to sinks Wm-N minus sources N and adds 2L for absolute changes, giving Wm-2N+2L.
S2.1.1.1 states each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate with a norm-one vector hence nonalternating, and by splitting off unit lines and absorbing alternating planes has an orthonormal basis.
S2.1.1.2 states weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors (even support intersection) and q_V-q_U = Σ wt(v)[v·x] mod 4 over an orthonormal basis of the residual E.
S2.1.1.3 says each basis vector has odd weight, so its factor i^{±[v·x]} = (1+i^{±1})/2+(1-i^{±1})/2 (-1)^{v·x}, which after conjugation by H^{⊗m} is the translation kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse.
The plan states one kernel per residual vector and s_c kernels over the network (S2.1.1, S2.1.1.4) but never that on k columns each vector gives one factor K^{⊗k} acting on all k columns.

S2.1.1.5 gives frame I for zero labels, C^{⊗m} for full labels, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of u_a repaired by Z corrections before and after plus scalar i^{27k}; the negation of the X outputs is only covered by S2.1.2.2's 'undoing of the signed bank exchange' and C=iZC^{-1}Z is not written for this step.
S1.1.1.4.3 states L_b/N<1/2 so s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b falls short of W_b m by N-2L_b>0.
The value η_c=73/19906842167500 is not stated anywhere in the plan; S2.1.1.4 gives only the symbolic complex deficit 2N-2L_c.

S1.1.4.3 gives deficit > 20·2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-η_b)=s_b/W_b (quoting the paper's 'both deficits' sentence) and S5.1.1 fixes τ=σ=1-2^{-50}, though the chain is spelled out only for the bit deficit.

S1.1.2.1 states the elimination: pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost nonzero entry, clearing by lower-triangular operations, one rank-one block isolated per pivot so Π has exactly a ones (with the A=0 case).

S1.1.2.2 states one fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator and diagonal numerator in the finite table of factors and inverses, so the identities hold over Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.

S1.1.2.3 states a lower-triangular change of H or D costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each multiplied by a unit plus a combination of still-original earlier coordinates.
S1.1.2.4 realizes each one of Π as D_j+=H_i, an interchange of H_i and D_j, then D_j=H_i-D_j, and S1.1.2.5 states Π has a ones so exactly a interchanges are used.
The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3 and B=s+E (S2.5.1) and writes Δ=⌈C_0 d^20⌉, but never defines ν, C_1=max{20,ν+3} or C_0=128mB^2, and the values ν=11 do not appear.
S2.5.1 states a chain gains at most E=64(W+m+1)^3 per network invocation and at most 8e at a leaf, so A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E at an internal node.

S2.5.1 states the unrolled bound A(e)≤8dB^{k+1}≤8B^2d^{ν+1} and total at most C_0 d^20, although ν is undefined and the step B^{k+1}≤B^2 d^ν (via B≤m^ν, k≤⌈log_m d⌉) is only asserted through the quote.
S2.5.2 states depth-j values lie in 2^{-(p+j)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^j so p+Δ fractional and Δ+3 integer/sign bits are exact, and S2.5.3 gives 20ε<1 hence Δ=o(p).
S2.5.4 states every row of H_0^{⊗D} has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays, and componentwise truncation keeps the disk with error below √2·2^{-p}.

summary: 21 of 26 sub-steps present. Absent: B3 (complex central coefficient), L1 (residual table), P3 (k-column tensoring of kernels), R3 (η_c value), S1 (constants ν, C_1, C_0 undefined). No sub-step is wrong. Borderline presents: L2 (inclusion stated, h-2 complement not), R4 (chain shown for the bit deficit), S3 (inequality asserted, ν undefined), P4 (X-output negation only as 'undoing the signed bank exchange').
